name: Coromandel International Ltd
title: Coromandel International Ltd - 506395 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA up 16% to INR 494 crores despite fertiliser margin compression; subsidy receivables fell to INR 2,199 crores from INR 3,785 crores in September, but Middle East raw-material spike leaves Q2 margins unclear.

capex.quote: we are on our way to commission this plant by December of this financial year.

triggers.label: Phos acid price USD 1,290 → 1,360
triggers.quote: Phosphoric Acid price was fixed at USD 1,360 as against the previous of USD 1,290.

triggers.label: Subsidy receivable down to INR 2,199 cr
triggers.quote: it has come down sequentially quarter -on-quarter from INR 3,785 crores at the end of September to INR 2,199 crores.

triggers.label: Fertiliser EBITDA/t below INR 3,500 in Q4
triggers.quote: it was less than INR 3,500 for fourth quarter.

triggers.label: Sarigam +20,000 t Mancozeb expansion
triggers.quote: we are expanding another 20,000 tons at Sarigam. That project is underway, and should come through by middle of this year.

guidance.quote: We are on our way to commission this plant by December of this financial year.
Overall, we can see a revenue growth of 20%-25% besides the capacity-driven growth in active ingredients
we are planning to increase the volume further by 30 %-40% in the current year.
going forward next year with the change in product portfolio, that should stabilize around 9% to 10%.
We doubt doing the same volume.

red_flags.label: Trading volume and working capital caution
red_flags.quote: We also want to be conscious on working capital liquidity.

red_flags.label: Subsidy receivables still INR 2,168 cr
red_flags.quote: Subsidy outstanding at the end of March stands at INR 2,168 crores compared with INR 1,654 crores in the previous year.

red_flags.label: Dhaksha impairment
red_flags.quote: we have taken the diminution in the value of investment relating to D haksha.

evasions.quote: Very difficult to predict at this point of time.
Every day is a new day, we are not able to predict anything.
It does not make sense even to look at either product margin or Phos Acid value gap.
